top_jobs.job: When Google reports a 6 times return and I suspect most of it is people typing our name, help me see what searches without our name really return and how many new customers they bring, so I judge Google on the buyers it finds, not the ones who were coming anyway
top_jobs.metric: non-brand return on ad spend and new customers from Google non-brand, per month

top_jobs.job: When the Google bill arrives and I cannot see what I paid for, help me find the searches, products and Performance Max corners that take money and never sell, so I stop paying for traffic that was never going to buy
top_jobs.metric: share of Google spend on search terms and products with no sale in 30 days

top_jobs.job: When almost all Google spend sits on our name and ready-to-buy searches, help me split spend by top, middle and bottom of funnel and move what sells on Meta and in search between the two, so I reach buyers before they know our name
top_jobs.metric: share of Google spend on top and middle of funnel searches, and new customers from them

top_jobs.job: When best sellers drop out of Shopping for a missing detail or a price mismatch, help me catch it the same day and fix the feed, so I stop losing sales I never see
top_jobs.metric: share of top 50 products approved and serving in Shopping

top_jobs.job: When I run Google myself or check the freelancer, help me look at 5 numbers in 20 minutes each Monday and add money only when the account has earned it, so I keep it safe without becoming an expert
top_jobs.metric: weeks the Monday check was done, and budget changes made with a written reason

jobs.job: Split last 90 days of Search, Shopping and Performance Max into brand and non-brand, and show spend, sales, return and new customer share for each
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then on the 1st of each month

inputs.need: search terms and Performance Max search insights, last 90 days
brand name, product names and common misspellings
orders marked new or returning buyer
brand and non-brand sorting of every term

steps: Pull 90 days of search terms per campaign type
Tag each term brand or non-brand, and list the 20 biggest brand terms found inside non-brand campaigns
Sum spend, sales, return and new customer share for each side
Put the dollars of brand spend hiding in cold campaigns on one line
Founder reads the split and signs the non-brand return floor
jobs.output: a 2 row table (brand, non-brand) by campaign type, with spend, sales, return and new customer share, plus the brand leak in dollars
jobs.next: feeds 12-04 (cost per new customer ceiling) and 12-18 (Monday check)

watch.metric: non-brand return on ad spend, brand excluded

jobs.drives: new customers from Google non-brand per month

jobs.job: Match the purchases Google claims each week to store orders, and mark each as new or returning, kept or returned
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: Google Ads conversions by campaign with click ids
orders with UTM, click id, new vs returning and refunds
GA4 purchases by source
matching rules by click id, UTM and date

steps: Pull last week's Google conversions and store orders
Match by click id first, then UTM and date
Count matched, Google only, store only, returned and returning buyer orders per campaign
Flag any campaign where store-matched sales are 25 percent off Google's count
Check 10 matches by hand and log any rule that is wrong
jobs.output: a weekly table per campaign: Google says, store sees, new buyers, returned, gap in percent

watch.metric: gap between Google purchases and store-matched purchases

jobs.drives: trust in Google's return and the right bids

jobs.job: Test whether brand search buys sales we would get anyway: pause brand search in half of matched regions for 4 weeks and compare orders
jobs.trigger: once, when brand spend is over 20 percent of Google spend and few rivals bid on our name

inputs.need: auction insights on brand terms: who bids and how often
orders by state or region, last 12 weeks
organic clicks on brand queries by region
founder sign-off on a 4 week test

steps: Read auction insights: if a rival shows on our name over 20 percent of the time, stop and defend instead
Pick 2 groups of regions with matching order trends over 12 weeks
Pause brand search in one group only
After 4 weeks, compare total orders and brand organic clicks in both groups
Write the verdict: keep, cut or bid lower, with dollars saved or lost per month
jobs.output: a 4 week holdout read with orders lost or kept, and a keep or cut decision
jobs.next: feeds 12-19 (scaling gates) and 13-12 (affiliates on brand terms)

watch.metric: orders in paused regions vs control regions

jobs.drives: spend saved on clicks we would get free

jobs.job: Set a cost per new customer ceiling for Google non-brand from first order margin, and flag mid-month when it is crossed
jobs.trigger: once, then checked on the 15th of each month

inputs.need: gross profit per first order by product
how much of a first order's profit the founder will spend to win it
non-brand spend and store-matched new customers month to date
monthly Google budget plan

steps: Compute the ceiling: first order profit times the share the founder will spend
Each 15th, divide month to date non-brand spend by store-matched new customers
Project where spend and cost per new customer will land at month end
If over the ceiling, list the 3 campaigns driving it and the budget change for each
Founder approves any cut over $500
jobs.output: a ceiling number and a mid-month flag with 3 named budget changes

watch.metric: non-brand cost per new customer vs the ceiling

jobs.drives: customers bought at a profit

jobs.job: Pull every search term with spend and no sale in 90 days, sort by cost, and add the clear misses as negatives with a reason
jobs.trigger: once, then every 2 weeks

inputs.need: search terms with cost, clicks and purchases, 90 days
current negative keyword lists
products we sell and do not sell
junk and wrong-intent sorting

steps: Pull terms with 10 or more clicks and 0 purchases
Sort by cost and tag each: wrong product, job seeker, free, how to, rival, maybe
A person checks the top 50 by hand so no term that sells elsewhere is blocked
Add clear misses as phrase or exact negatives with the reason and date
Leave the maybes for 30 more days and recheck
jobs.output: a negative list with reasons, and dollars of 90 day waste it would have stopped

watch.metric: spend on terms with no sale

jobs.drives: non-brand return on ad spend

jobs.job: Map where Performance Max money goes (brand, past buyers, video, display, auto-made assets) and turn off the settings nobody chose
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.need: Performance Max channel report and search insights
account settings: search partners, display expansion, auto-apply, location option
customer list for new customer goal and exclusions
Google Ads ideas on default settings and Performance Max

steps: Pull Performance Max spend by channel and the share of search insights that are brand terms
List every default that leaks: search partners, display expansion, auto-apply, presence or interest, auto-made text and video
Price each leak in 30 day spend and sales
Add brand exclusions and the new customer goal where the numbers say so
Founder approves the change list before anyone clicks
jobs.output: a one page map: Performance Max spend by channel and brand share, plus a priced list of settings to switch

watch.metric: share of Performance Max spend on brand terms and past buyers

jobs.drives: new customers per dollar in Performance Max

jobs.job: Label every Shopping product by margin tier and by sell or no-sell, then split campaigns so money moves from 20 no-sale products to the ones that sell
jobs.trigger: once, then monthly

inputs.need: product-level Shopping and Performance Max report, 30 and 90 days
unit cost and margin per SKU
stock per SKU
custom labels written into the feed

steps: Mark each product high, mid or low margin
Mark products with 50 or more clicks and no sale in 30 days as no-sale
Write both labels into the feed as custom labels
Split into campaigns by label, with a return target per tier from its margin
Read in 4 weeks: spend share and profit per tier
jobs.output: a labelled feed and a campaign split by margin tier, with no-sale products capped

watch.metric: share of Shopping spend on high margin products

jobs.drives: gross profit from Shopping

jobs.job: Pull Google spend off any product with under 14 days of stock and put it back the day stock lands
jobs.trigger: daily after the stock sync

inputs.need: stock and 14 day sales rate per SKU
restock dates
product-level Shopping spend
stock custom label kept current

steps: Compute days of stock per SKU from the 14 day sales rate
Label products under 14 days as low stock in the feed
Exclude low stock products from Shopping and Performance Max listing groups
Remove the label when stock lands and log the dates
Send a weekly list of spend saved and restocks waiting
jobs.output: a daily low stock label and a weekly note of spend held back

watch.metric: spend on products under 14 days of stock

jobs.drives: no ad dollars on products we cannot ship

jobs.job: Tag every Google search term by funnel stage (problem, category, comparison, product, brand) and show spend and new customer share per stage next to Meta's split
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then on the 1st of each month

inputs.need: search terms with spend and purchases, 90 days
orders marked new or returning
Meta spend by awareness level
funnel rubric: 5 example terms per stage

steps: Tag each term: problem words are top, category and 'best' or 'vs' are middle, product and brand are bottom
A person checks the 50 highest spend tags and fixes the rubric
Sum spend, sales and new customer share for top, middle and bottom
Lay Google's split next to Meta's awareness split
Write the gap line: the stage where we spend least and new customers are cheapest
jobs.output: a funnel table: 3 stages by spend, sales, return and new customer share, beside Meta's, plus the gap line
jobs.next: feeds 12-10 (top of funnel test), 12-11 (terms into Meta hooks) and 11-paid-social

watch.metric: share of Google spend on top and middle of funnel terms

jobs.drives: new customers from Google per month

jobs.job: Run one top of funnel test on YouTube or Demand Gen with the 3 best problem aware videos from Meta, past buyers excluded, read at 4 weeks on brand search lift and new customers
jobs.trigger: once Search and Shopping pass the scaling gates in 12-19

inputs.need: Meta videos tagged unaware or problem aware with hold rate and cost per new customer
brand search impressions baseline, 8 weeks
budget cap for tests
customer list to exclude

steps: Stop if the gates in 12-19 are not met and write why
Pick 3 Meta videos tagged unaware or problem aware with the best hold rate
Recut the first 5 seconds so the product shows by second 3 and the problem is said out loud
Set a weekly budget of at least 10 times the target cost per new customer, past buyers excluded
Founder approves the budget and the stop line
At 4 weeks, read brand search lift and store new customers, not Google's last click
jobs.output: a live top of funnel test with a budget, a stop line and a read date
jobs.next: feeds 11-paid-social (which videos travel) and 12-19 (next budget step)

watch.metric: brand search impressions vs the 8 week baseline

jobs.drives: new customers who did not know us

jobs.job: Turn the top 20 non-brand search terms that sell into 20 Meta hooks in the searcher's own words
jobs.trigger: monthly, before the Meta creative round

inputs.need: non-brand search terms with purchases, 90 days
Search Console queries with clicks to product pages
avatars and pain points
allowed claims

steps: Pull the top 20 non-brand terms by purchases and the top 20 queries by clicks
Group them into pain, use, feature and comparison
Map each group to one avatar and pain pair
Write 2 hooks per group in the searcher's words, checked against allowed claims
Founder strikes any hook that does not sound like us
Hand the sheet to 11-paid-social as one hook test batch
jobs.output: a hook sheet: 10 groups, 20 hooks, each with its source term and Google conversion rate

watch.metric: thumb stop rate and cost per purchase of search-born hooks vs control

jobs.drives: new customers from Meta

jobs.job: Bring the 5 angles that won on Meta in the last 60 days into Google search ads and Performance Max assets, as a 50/50 test
jobs.trigger: monthly, after the Meta round is read

inputs.need: Meta winners with angle and hook tags
responsive search ad asset ratings
allowed claims
voice rules

steps: List the 5 Meta angles with the lowest cost per new customer
Write 3 headlines of 30 characters and 2 descriptions per angle
Replace only assets rated low, keep the best
Run as a 50/50 ad variation in the top 3 non-brand ad groups
Read at 4 weeks on click rate and conversion rate
jobs.output: an ad variation test live in 3 ad groups, with the angle each headline came from
jobs.next: feeds 12-13 (price and offer headlines) and 17-06 (title rewrites)

watch.metric: click rate and conversion rate of non-brand search ads

jobs.drives: non-brand sales

jobs.job: Rewrite headlines on the top 10 non-brand ad groups to lead with product, price or offer where rivals show clearer prices, and check the landing page says the same
jobs.trigger: once, then when auction insights show a new rival

inputs.need: auction insights and top of page rate for top 10 terms
mobile screenshots of the results page for the top 10 terms
live prices, offers and shipping
landing page per ad group

steps: Screenshot the results page for the top 10 terms on a phone
Note each rival's price, offer and shipping line
Write 3 headlines per group with product and price or offer first
Check each landing page shows the same price and offer above the fold, and fix it if not
Launch as ad variations and read at 3 weeks
jobs.output: 10 ad groups with new headlines and matched landing pages

watch.metric: click rate on the top 10 non-brand terms

jobs.drives: non-brand sales at the same spend

jobs.job: Check the Merchant Center feed every morning for disapprovals, price and stock mismatch and missing details, ranked by each product's sales, and fix best sellers the same day
jobs.trigger: daily

inputs.need: Merchant Center diagnostics
live prices, sale prices and stock
sales per product, 30 days
feed check rules

steps: Pull disapprovals, warnings and limited items
Compare feed price, sale price and stock with the live site
Rank problems by the product's 30 day sales
Send the top 5 fixes with the exact field to change
Recheck the next morning and log the time to fix
jobs.output: a morning list of feed problems ranked by sales at stake, with the field to fix

watch.metric: share of top 50 products approved and serving

jobs.drives: Shopping sales

jobs.job: Rewrite the Shopping titles of 20 products that sell on Meta but get few Shopping views, to lead with the words buyers type
jobs.trigger: once, then each quarter

inputs.need: Shopping impressions and clicks per product
search terms per product
Search Console queries to product pages
Meta sales per product

steps: List 20 products with good Meta sales and low Shopping impressions
For each, pull the terms that already bring clicks and the ones rivals use
Write the title as type, key feature, size or colour, brand, in under 70 characters for the front
A person checks each title is true to the product
Push to the feed as a supplemental file and read impressions at 3 weeks
jobs.output: 20 new titles in the feed, each with the terms it now leads with

watch.metric: Shopping impressions for the 20 products

jobs.drives: Shopping sales

jobs.job: Switch on the free Merchant Center extras we never used: free listings, promotions, shipping and returns, product ratings and store rating
jobs.trigger: once, then checked each quarter

inputs.need: Merchant Center settings
reviews app product ratings feed
return window and shipping times
live promotions calendar

steps: List each free extra and whether it is on
Connect the product ratings feed from the reviews app
Enter shipping and return policy so badges can show
Load the next month's promotions
Recheck in 30 days that stars, badges and promos show
jobs.output: a checklist of extras switched on, with the date each went live

watch.metric: free listing clicks

jobs.drives: Shopping click rate at no cost

jobs.job: Check rival Shopping prices on our top 20 products each week and pull back spend where a rival is 20 percent cheaper
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: price competitiveness report
rival list
margin per SKU and lowest price allowed
click rate and sales per product

steps: Pull benchmark prices for the top 20 products
Flag any product where a rival is 20 percent or more cheaper
For flagged products, cut the bid or move to the low tier if click rate or sales fell
Send the list to the founder for a price or offer call where margin allows
Log each call with the date
jobs.output: a weekly price gap list with the action taken on each product

watch.metric: cost per sale on flagged products

jobs.drives: profit on Shopping

jobs.job: Run a 20 minute Monday check on 5 numbers (non-brand return, new customers, spend vs plan, wasted terms, feed errors) and make one change at most
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: last week's spend, sales and search terms
store-matched new customers
monthly budget plan
feed error count

steps: Read the 5 numbers with last week and 4 week average side by side
Mark any number that moved more than 20 percent
Find the one cause behind the biggest move before touching bids
Make one change, write why, and set the date to read it
Log it in the decisions list
jobs.output: a one page Monday card with 5 numbers, the one change and its read date

watch.metric: weeks the Monday check was done

jobs.drives: steady non-brand return and fewer panic changes

jobs.job: Pass 5 scaling gates before adding $5,000 a month to Google: tracking matches, non-brand over the floor for 8 weeks, feed clean, search impression share lost to budget, stock to cover
jobs.trigger: before any budget rise over 20 percent

inputs.need: store-matched return and new customers, 8 weeks
impression share lost to budget per campaign
stock cover for top products
floors and caps

steps: Check each of the 5 gates and mark pass or fail with the number
If any fail, write the fix and stop
If all pass, add money in steps of 20 percent a week to campaigns losing share to budget
Read cost per new customer each week and stop at the ceiling from 12-04
jobs.output: a gate sheet with pass or fail and, if passed, a 4 week budget ramp

watch.metric: non-brand cost per new customer during the ramp

jobs.drives: more new customers at a profit

jobs.job: Get Google ready 3 weeks before Black Friday: budget ramp, promotions in the feed, stock cover, and landing pages that match the ads
jobs.trigger: 21 days before each peak on the calendar

inputs.need: peak dates and offers
offer terms
stock for top 30 products
last year's peak spend and sales by day

steps: Set the daily budget ramp from last year's curve and this year's cap
Load promotions into Merchant Center 10 days ahead for approval
Check stock cover for the top 30 products and label low ones
Check each ad's offer matches its landing page
Founder signs the plan; a person checks it live on day 1
jobs.output: a signed peak plan with budget by day, approved promotions and checked pages

watch.metric: Google sales on peak days vs plan

jobs.drives: peak revenue

new_enablers.name: Search term sorter
new_enablers.what: Sorts every Google search term from Search, Shopping and Performance Max insights into brand, rival brand, category, problem, comparison and junk. Keeps 90 days of cost, sales and new customers per term, and the negative keyword list with the reason and date for each entry.
inputs: Google Ads search terms and Performance Max search insights
brand and product name list with misspellings
new vs returning buyers from store orders
powers: terms that cost and never sell
the funnel stage of each term
converting terms to reuse in Meta hooks, titles and articles

new_enablers.name: Store order match
new_enablers.what: Matches the purchases an ad platform claims to real store orders by click id, UTM and date. Marks each as new or returning buyer, kept or returned, and shows the gap between what the platform says and what the store saw.
inputs: store orders with UTM and click ids
powers: return and cost per new customer from the store's view

new_enablers.name: Feed doctor
new_enablers.what: Checks the Merchant Center feed every day against the live site: price, sale price, stock, shipping, GTIN, titles and images. Lists disapprovals and warnings ranked by the product's sales, and suggests title fixes in the words buyers type.
powers: best sellers back in Shopping the same day
no suspension from price or stock mismatch
custom labels by margin and stock
